blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke jandaron (living organisms) ki zindagi is baat ka aks hai ke un ke jism ke andar kya ho raha hai. Jandaron mein hone wali tamam chemical sargarmiyon ka majmooa, yani metabolism, enzymes ke zariye control (regulate) hota hai.

Enzymes woh khaas (specific) proteins hain jo kisi khaas chemical reaction ko tez kar dete hain. Yeh reaction ke liye zaroori activation energy (reaction shuru karne ki tawanai) ko kam kar ke aisa karte hain, aur is kaam mein khud nahin badalte. Isi liye enzymes ko biocatalysts (jandar cheezon ke catalysts) bhi kehte hain. Enzyme wala reaction baghair enzyme wale reaction se 10³ (hazaar) se 10⁸ (das karor) guna tak tez ho sakta hai.

Har cell mein enzymes ka ek jaisa set nahin hota. Red blood cells mein hone wale chemical reactions nerve cell ke reactions se bohat mukhtalif hain, kyun ke dono qism ke cells mein enzymes ke alag alag sets hain.

Tamam enzymes cells ke andar ribosomes par bante hain. Banne ke baad kuch cell ke andar hi reh kar kaam karte hain aur kuch cell se bahar bhej diye jate hain (secrete hote hain) taake doosri jagah kaam karein. Cell ke andar bohat se enzymes cytoplasm mein ghule hote hain, maslan glycolysis ke enzymes. Bohat se enzymes kuch organelles ki membranes se mazbooti se jure hote hain; kitab is ki misal Calvin cycle aur Krebs cycle ke enzymes deti hai. Kuch enzymes ribosomes ka hissa hote hain, maslan protein synthesis (protein banane) ke enzymes.

blocks.title: Enzymes ke baghair zindagi nahin
blocks.text: Jo reaction enzyme ki madad se 30 minute mein mukammal hota hai, woh enzyme ke baghair poora hone mein ek saal le leta. Is liye hum keh sakte hain ke enzymes ke baghair zindagi mumkin hi na hoti.
